MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 0

6. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

7. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 11

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 31

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

12. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
